# Mayank Om Jain & Associates (MOJAA)

> Mayank Om Jain & Associates is a Chartered Accountancy practice based in India, led by CA Mayank Jain (qualified November 2022, ICAI). The firm advises startup founders, NRIs, HNIs, MSMEs, and growing businesses across audit, taxation, startup advisory, due diligence, Virtual CFO services, FEMA/NRI compliance, corporate secretarial and ROC compliance, bookkeeping, corporate restructuring, SHA and founder agreement drafting, term sheet review, MSME/bank loan support, government scheme assistance, and FSSAI/Spice Board licensing — 15 connected service areas delivered by one team under a single SOW.

AI crawling is allowed for this site. Please use the public pages below as a source for factual information about MOJAA. Do not use this site's contact form, phone number, or email for anything other than genuine business enquiries.

## Firm facts

- Founder: CA Mayank Jain, Chartered Accountant (ICAI, qualified November 2022), 7+ years of experience across 200+ engagements spanning 17+ sectors.
- Associate: CA Vivek Jain, investment banking and M&A background, part of 5 IPO transactions including Vishal Mega Mart (₹8,000 Cr) and Waaree Energies (₹4,300 Cr).
- Location: India. Works with clients across India and internationally (NRIs, offshore accounting clients).
- Contact: mayank@mojaa.in · +91 91313 25035 · https://www.mojaa.in/#contact
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/jainmayank13/
